ranges.text:
run: python -m scripts.build_options_flow_attention || echo "::warning::build_options_flow_attention failed (non-fatal — reflex dormant this run)"
      - name: commit engine outputs
        if: always()   # commit the freshly-built pages even if a LATER optional builder times out or is cancelled. pages.yml deploys the COMMITTED main tree, so a skipped commit = stale live site. The builders are individually resilient (each leaves the prior page in place on its own error), so partial output is never broken — committing what built beats shipping nothing.
        run: bash scripts/ci/daily_engine_commit_outputs.sh
      - name: assemble machine-consumable feeds (site/feeds -> R2)
        if: always()
        # Handoff H4 (2026-07-02 incident): risk_radar snapshot, froth/dislocation
        # logs, group_flow meta, RRG rotation, event calendar, intl spillover,
        # per-sector breadth — one flat dir whose _manifest.json bulk consumers
        # (Mastermind bot) sync against. Never fatal; missing sources are skipped.
        run: python -m scripts.build_feeds || echo "::warning::build_feeds failed (non-fatal)"
      - name: publish heavy per-ticker stores to R2 (additive; no-op without creds)
        if: always()
        env:
          R2_ENDPOINT: ${{ secrets.R2_ENDPOINT }}
          R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          R2_BUCKET: ${{ secrets.R2_BUCKET }}
        # US-evening shard owns the US/intl/canada/subsector stores; CN/HK go via asia-close.yml.
        # Content-hash skip -> only deltas upload. Still committed to git for now (Pages fallback);
        # the git de-bloat + Pages slim-down is the follow-up increment once the client reads R2.
        # massive_stock_day moved to the COLLECT job (2026-07-29) — it is restored, advanced and
        # published there. An engine checkout never holds that store, so listing it here only ever
        # produced a nightly publish_r2 refusal warning (under the _DATA_DIR_MIN_FILES floor).
        run: python -m scripts.publish_r2 --dirs ohlc,intlohlc,canadaohlc,subsectorohlc,subsectorohlc_russell,subsectorohlc_nasdaq,stockdata,intlstockdata,canadastockdata,intraday,feeds,stock_personality,oddsmatrix,odds_ohlcv,seasonalitydata/entities || echo "::warning::R2 publish failed (non-fatal)"
